definitions.MUST: helper-cut: every returning ordinary CFG walk hits 0x00686000 or a callee already MUST. Painted BLOCKED_EXTERNAL in progress.py.
definitions.MAY: helper-cut: some returning walks hit the MUST set, some do not. Not BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
definitions.INDEPENDENT: helper-cut independent_count = reachable_high - must - may (no ordinary path to allocator). progress NO_PATH_TO_EXTERNAL_HELPER is the per-function label for that class among classified rows.
definitions.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_dashboard: Exactly the current helper-cut MUST set (74). Not the eight protected-boundary roots from the Ghidra audit.

current_helper_cut.source: tools/uc_phase16.py + uc_phase14_cut.analyze(); reachable high-confidence call graph

historical_phase14_helper_cut.note: Phase-14 cut used an earlier reachable-HIGH population (~6.5k). Phase-16 regenerated helper-cut.json over ~22.6k reachable HIGH.

why_counts_differ_from_phase14_doc: Different analysis stage and reachable-HIGH population. Phase-14 documented MUST=11/MAY=31/INDEP=6456 on ~6498 reachable HIGH. Current helper-cut.json (Phase 16+) has MUST=74/MAY=139/INDEP=22394 on reachable_high=22607. Dashboard BLOCKED_EXTERNAL=74 tracks current MUST, not the historical Phase-14 MUST=11.
